mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate buprenorphine's CNS depression and increase risk of respiratory depression; both drugs may also cause QT prolongation.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and respiratory status closely; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly; consider dose reduction of buprenorphine if renal impairment develops; use with caution and ensure adequate monitoring.
